sourceQualifiedImages.caption: Transverse T2WI MR in the same patient as the prior 2 images shows high signal in the mass as well as the normal internal architecture of the uterus and cervix .
sourceQualifiedImages.label: SDX-23

sourceQualifiedImages.caption: On T1WI MR, dermoids have internal high signal that is consistent with fat .

sourceQualifiedImages.caption: Axial CECT in the same patient shows the layering areas of fat density in the left ovarian dermoid . A smaller dermoid is also present in the right ovary . 10-20% of dermoids are bilateral. Note the intrauterine device in the uterus.

sourceQualifiedImages.caption: Gross pathology shows the typical appearance of a Rokitansky nodule within the dissected mature cystic teratoma. Hair arises from the nodule.

sourceQualifiedImages.caption: Gross pathology shows the resected specimen with twisted vascular pedicle , solid nodule , and tangled hair .

Hemorrhagic Ovarian Cyst — autonomous build complete

Core Validation Gate: PASSED. Core evidence status: USED. The Core source was the uploaded Core Radiology: A Visual Approach to Diagnostic Imaging, 2nd ed.  I located the relevant material in Genitourinary Imaging → Ovaries and adnexa, principally book pages 314–320, with the direct hemorrhagic-cyst discussion on 316–317; I also cross-checked adnexal torsion on page 315, endometrioma on page 318, ovarian-neoplasm discriminators on pages 319–320, and Obstetrical Imaging page 330 for the corpus-luteum/ectopic ring-of-fire pitfall.

The Core validation digest and Core Summary established these board-relevant points:

- Physiologic bleeding occurs at ovulation, creating the corpus hemorrhagicum before evolution to the corpus luteum; hemorrhagic cysts most commonly represent hemorrhage into a functional corpus luteum cyst.
- Core describes acute hemorrhagic cysts as potentially hyperechoic with posterior enhancement, later developing characteristic web-like internal echoes; a retractile mural clot has a concave margin and absent Doppler flow, whereas a true solid mural nodule has a convex margin and internal flow.
- Core gives the >5 cm → short-term ultrasound follow-up in 6–12 weeks pivot and states that failure to resolve raises consideration of endometrioma.
- Endometrioma provides the major persistent blood-product mimic: homogeneous low-level echoes, posterior enhancement, no internal Doppler flow, and on MRI typically T1 hyperintensity with T2 shading and lack of fat suppression.
- The ectopic-pregnancy cross-check confirmed that ring-of-fire flow is nonspecific and may occur with corpus luteum; proving intraovarian versus extraovarian location and testing separate motion with gentle probe pressure are the key safety moves. Core also confirms that preserved ovarian flow does not exclude torsion because of dual blood supply.

Whole-source coverage audit completed from full Core pages and full article text. Core Summary attached; derived from full Core coverage, not from validation digest. Card generation used full-source review, not digest summary. The committed integration mode was Core + Article synthesis: Core + RadPrimer + STATdx. Direct HOC ultrasound, definition, differential, physiology, and management were present in both source families; the richer direct HOC MRI signal-variability and CT rupture/sentinel-clot/active-bleeding material came from RadPrimer/STATdx. Nuclear-medicine appearance and a stable HOC-specific sensitivity/specificity metric were absent, so neither was fabricated and no external literature was inserted.

For SECTION A, the 33 selected primary images were resolved into 24 cases using only the explicitly supplied same-patient clusters. All 24 were eligible, none were excluded, and exactly 24 PRIMARY UNKNOWN notes were generated. The selected-image audit passed: all 33 selected primary images are represented, while STATdx image 17 (SDX-17) remains intentionally archived as the exact duplicate of RadPrimer image 10 (RP-10).

The final internally validated deck contains 44 cards: 24 PRIMARY UNKNOWN, 3 Differential Drills, 1 Definition, 2 Mechanism, 2 Boards Trap, 1 Epidemiology/etiology-frequency, and 11 High-Yield cards. Ultrasound, MRI, CT, the four-pattern sonographic framework, follow-up thresholds, postmenopausal pivots, rupture management, natural history, and major neoplasm-safety features are all encoded. Caption-integrity, trigger-isolation, unique-code, blank-Tags, image-accounting, deck-balance, and preview-to-TSV identity audits passed.

Total cards to export: 44. Expected TSV lines: 44. The final TSV has 44 physical lines, exactly 22 tab-separated columns per line, no header, blank Tags column on every row, and no literal line breaks inside fields.

The source-qualified RadPrimer/STATdx media filenames are preserved in the card image fields. The authenticated image endpoints themselves were not retrievable from this execution environment, so I did not substitute, fabricate, or silently replace any media binaries.
